source.author: Imran Parkar
source.blueprint_note: The guide's stated alignment, matched against the supplied BCSP CSP11 Examination Blueprint V.2024.04.24 (47 objectives). Whether this is BCSP's current blueprint has not been verified for this course version.
source.study_plan_note: The guide's 150-hour plan weighted by exam share is an optional planning estimate, not a course requirement.
